scope: backend/app/ensemble.py implemented per ensemble-construction-engine-v1.md; 12 unit tests against its own acceptance checklist; smoke-tested on real data combining atr_normalized + amihud_illiquidity
note: User-directed: "2 factor is not enough i know, but at least > 1 so can do a smoke test of new facility work or not." Built composite_alpha_scores (alpha model), shrinkage_covariance (risk model), construct_portfolio (rank-and-weight optimizer with ADR 0004 position cap) exactly per the design doc. All ADR 0010 sec1 constraints held on real data: 100.00% gross exposure, ~0% net, symmetric 98/98 long-short groups. Caught and fixed a real bug during the run: a recently-added SP500 member (e.g. PSKY, added 2025-08-08) had a valid factor score but incomplete 252-day return history, silently poisoning the covariance diagonal via np.cov NaN propagation and zeroing the entire long side (long_count=0 on the first run). Fixed by requiring complete return history as its own eligibility condition. Byproduct finding: atr_normalized cross-sectional form does not survive point-in-time correction (Sharpe -0.012, confidence multiplier 0.0), same pattern as CS-01 on a different signal -- the own-history ATR Vol Premium Tier A strategy is unaffected, a different claim.
